verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents automatic categorization (up to 98% auto-categorized), custom rules creation, batch categorization, and an 'ask AI' assist for miscategorized transactions, which together suggest a feedback loop where corrections refine future categorization. However, there is no explicit documentation confirming the AI model learns from user corrections over time. missing for 10: explicit statement/evidence that corrections feed back into and improve the categorization model, and any hands-on/independent verification of this learning behavior.
